title: Move a note into a Windows practice system with noctune for Windows
tagline: Your note into your PIMS. On Windows, too.

headline: Your noctune note,
into a Windows PIMS.
scenes.narration: Your practice system runs on Windows, or over Remote Desktop. noctune works there too.

headline: Open the panel.
Pick the patient.
scenes.narration: Pick the patient's note in the noctune panel, beside the record.

headline: Click a field.
Press Ctrl+Shift+E.
scenes.narration: Click a field. Press Control Shift E. Subjective goes in.

headline: Each press,
the next section.
scenes.narration: Each press, the next section. Objective. Assessment. Plan.

headline: Discharge too.
Then Save in your PIMS.
scenes.narration: Discharge instructions too. It only ever pastes. It never saves or sends anything for you. You read it, then Save in your PIMS.

headline: On the PC,
remote, or in Chrome.
instructionCard: In Chrome, with the browser extension
scenes.narration: On the PC, over Remote Desktop or Citrix, and in Chrome with the browser extension.

headline: Early access is open.
scenes.narration: noctune for Windows. Early access is open.
